title: The robot vacuum and station are due for maintenance
message: Tap for details, then tap Handled when finished
detail: After all steps are completed, please tap Handled.

Please check and clean the filter. 
1. Open the top cover of the robot vacuum, press the dust compartment release button and pull the dust compartment upward to remove it. 
2. Take out the filter, gently tap the frame of the filter to remove dirt.
If necessary, the dust compartment and filter can be washed with water. Make sure they are completely dry before reinstalling.

Please check and clean the dirty water container and filter
1. Press the dirty water container release button and pull the dirty water container outward to remove it
2. Open the dirty water container cover, remove the filter, and rinse with clean water
3. Reinstall the filter, close the dirty water container cover, then attach the dirty water container to the back of the robot vacuum. A "click" means it is securely installed.

Please check and clean the roller bin.
Press the roller release button to remove the roller mop pad and clean the roller bin.

Please check and clean the water tray. 
1. Flip the robot vacuum over, Lift the roller mop, push forward the water tray release buckle, and remove the water guide channel
Rinse the water tray thoroughly, dry it, and then reinstall it.

Please check and clean the washboard.
1. Remove the washboard and its filter, then rinse them thoroughly with a brush under running water.
2. Dry the washboard and its filter with a dry cloth.
3. Reinstall the washboard until you hear a click to ensure it is securely in place.
4. Ensure the station's dirty water pipe sits in the groove of the washboard to prevent it from getting lifted and affecting use.
